description: This file defines functions for publishing health check data to Kafka and Loki. It includes utility functions for sending messages to Kafka topics and pushing logs to Loki with structured labels and entries.

methods.name: None send_to_kafka(bootstrap_servers: str, topic: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Sends a health report payload to a specified Kafka topic using confluent_kafka Producer.

methods.name: None push_to_loki(loki_url: str, tenant_id: Optional[str], labels: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Pushes log entries to Loki via HTTP API, with optional tenant ID and label parsing.

ctags.name: push_to_loki
ctags.pattern: /^def push_to_loki(loki_url: str, tenant_id: Optional[str], labels: str, entries: List[Dict[str, A/
ctags.signature: (loki_url: str, tenant_id: Optional[str], labels: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], logger: logging.Logger)

ctags.name: send_to_kafka
ctags.pattern: /^def send_to_kafka(bootstrap_servers: str, topic: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.L/
ctags.signature: (bootstrap_servers: str, topic: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger)
